snippet.title: CATACLYSM | Expansion Reveal | Hearthstone
snippet.description:
Brace yourselves for Deathwing's attack when CATACLYSM hits on March 17!

CATACLYSM has 135 new cards, the first-ever Deathwing Hero Card, the return of Colossals, and the brand-new Herald and Shatter keywords. Log in to Hearthstone now to get the Warmaster Blackthorn Legendary card for free!

🔥 Deathwing Hero Card: Deathwing's Battlecry lets you pick the CATACLYSM you want to unleash: topple the biggest enemy minion, raze the board with a wave of flame, enthrall powerful creatures to join your army, or summon your fearsome dragon progeny to the battlefield.

🔥 Colossal: Colossals are BIIIIIIIG. When you play a Colossal minion, they expand and take up multiple spaces on the board with appendage cards that as their arms, extra heads, gross tentacles, etc.

🔥 Herald: First, when you play a minion with Herald, a soldier of your Colossal will be summoned to the battlefield. Soldiers have the same effect as the Colossal’s appendages. This offers a taste of your Colossal’s immense power before it hits the board. The more you use Herald, the mightier Deathwing and your Colossal soldiers and appendages become. Herald twice to double their power. Herald two more times to double it again.

🔥 Shatter: When you draw a card with Shatter, it breaks into two pieces that move to opposite ends of your hand. You can play the pieces separately, but if you manage to bring them back together by playing the cards in between, they recombine into a single card that’s doubly strong.

Help the Hearthstone community unlock all the dragonflights to earn a free Legendary Ebyssian and two Signature copies of Envoy of the End! From February 9 - March 17, visit our 📌  CATACLYSM Rally Point page (https://hearthstone.blizzard.com/en-us/cataclysmrallypoint) to take part in the community’s effort to prepare for Deathwing’s attack.

In the upcoming CATACLYSM Pre-Release Tavern Brawl, you’ll be able to try out the Deathwing, Worldbreaker Hero Card! The Pre-Release Tavern Brawl runs from March 10 at 10:00 a.m. PDT to March 17 at 9:00 a.m. PDT.

CATACLYSM releases on March 17 - follow our social channels for card reveals and updates as the countdown begins.

📌 Pre-purchase the CATACLYSM Mega Bundle: https://us.shop.battle.net/en-us/product/hearthstone-cataclysm-mega-bundle?p=2040776#optLogin=true
📌 Announce Blog: https://hearthstone.blizzard.com/news/24245219
📌 Read the full 34.6 Patch Notes: https://hearthstone.blizzard.com/en-us/news/24242740
📌 CATACLYSM Card Library: https://hearthstone.blizzard.com/en-us/cards
